# Umber Calm for yazi

A warm, low-glare dark flavor with measured contrast. Part of [Umber Calm](https://github.com/ChristianOrrala/umber-calm).

Requires yazi 25.5.28 or newer (`[mgr]` section).

## Install

Copy this `umber-calm.yazi` folder to `~/.config/yazi/flavors/` and add to `~/.config/yazi/theme.toml`:

```toml
[flavor]
dark = "umber-calm"
```

`tmtheme.xml` colors code previews; it is the same file as the Umber Calm bat theme.
